paragraphs.text: General Kreat , also known as the the Boltbringer , is a goblin soldier from Ravnica .

Kreat was introduced as a charter in the Foundations Jumpstart on General Kreat, the Boltbringer as part of the Goblins Red Decklist . She is a green-skinned female goblin with white hair and a red uniform. General Kreat is a Boros general who carries an electrified sword, making crossing swords with her dangerous. As a reference to her being a general, her card's abilities make it so that any time a goblin attacks, she causes another goblin to join the battle. As a reference to her electrified sword, anytime an opponent introduces a creature, she deals damage to them.
